Container.Name: u1-print-bridge-converter
Container.Overview: Bambu/MakerWorld 3MF to Snapmaker U1 converter for the u1-print-bridge. The bridge API calls this sidecar over HTTP to rewrite Bambu project files (printer identity, G-code blocks, filament slots) into U1 project files before slicing. Optional: without it the bridge just uses the original file. Its API has no auth, so keep it LAN-only. Upstream project is PolyForm Noncommercial licensed (personal use).

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the converter web UI and API. The bridge API reaches it at http://<unraid-ip>:8084.
